title: Big emerald Sword
description: A mod which adds a powerful sword made of emeralds and lapis, bearing an unique attack and increased sweeping range.
body:
Adds a large emerald sword made with Emeralds, Lapis and a Lightning rod.
Recommended to use JEI or REI or such to view recipe in-game.
The sword has increased sweep due to it's size, meaning enemies that are further away can be hit by an attack. The sword can be right-clicked to launch an enemy into the air, stunning them, but also disabling your sword for a moment.
